description: DIRECT automated loading check — the reproduction of the manual live-run hook audit. Dispatches the real test-reviewer with android-testing injected the way /run-reviewers does (injectSkills + the Skill tool granted), then reads the Skill PreToolUse hook log (.skill-invocations.log the dispatch wrote) and asserts android-testing was actually INVOKED via the Skill tool. test-reviewer's built-in `testing` skill is @-referenced (inlined at prompt-build time, never a Skill call), so the log reflects only runtime Skill invocations — android-testing appearing there means the injected skill was genuinely loaded, not merely requested. This is why it lives in its own corpus run through run_fixture.py (which honors injectSkills), NOT the Phase-1 reviewer loop (which uses a fixed prompt and would ignore injection). Paired with reviewer-no-injection-control for attribution.
